steps.title: Web QA — Playwright harness, smoke suite and CI
steps.goal: `apps/web` gains a Playwright 1.62 harness (`apps/web/playwright.config.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/*`) that builds and starts the web app under a committed mock environment — no Supabase project, Stripe or network — and asserts that public pages render, forms validate, every `/admin` and `/o/*` route redirects anonymous visitors to `/login?next=…`, `/s/unknown` is a 404, the DESIGN §9 security headers are present on ordinary pages and correctly relaxed — differently — on `/s/*` (no-referrer, no-store) and `/embed/*` (strict-origin-when-cross-origin), `/api/cron/tick` and `/api/stripe/webhook` refuse unauthenticated or unsigned calls, and no secret value appears in HTML. The same suite runs against a deployed URL via `BASE_URL`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs it on every push, and `pnpm --filter web build` is warning-free. The env-gated full E2E, the accessibility pass and the states audit are 3.7b.

You are working in the ChurchAppCLD repository. CLAUDE.md loads `new_session_instructions.md` and `HANDOFF.md` automatically — follow the session-start checklist (new-session.sh, prompt_history.txt). Work on `main` unless I have named another branch in this session. This is step 3.7a "Web QA — Playwright harness, smoke suite and CI" of `docs/TODO.md`; read that step's 'Done when' list first. Read `docs/PLAN.md` §7–§8 and §12, and `docs/DESIGN.md` §8–§9, §11 (Phase 1 step 9, the Acceptance paragraph) and §12 before writing code. Build ONLY this step; do not start the next one.

## Goal
When you finish, `apps/web` has a Playwright 1.62 harness that runs the whole web app against a **mock environment** with no Supabase project, no Stripe and no network: `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` builds the app, starts it, and asserts that every public page renders, that form validation works, that every protected route redirects anonymous visitors to `/login?next=…`, that `/s/unknown` is a 404, that the security headers documented in DESIGN §9 are present on ordinary pages and correctly relaxed — in two different ways — on `/s/*` and `/embed/*`, that the cron and webhook routes refuse unauthenticated or unsigned calls, and that no secret value ever reaches HTML. The same suite runs against a deployed URL when `BASE_URL` is set (step 2.5's helper and step 3.9 use this). `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs the smoke suite on every push. `pnpm --filter web build` is warning-free. The env-gated full E2E, the accessibility pass and the empty/loading/error-state audit are step 3.7b — do not start them.

## Inputs / prior state
- Web app (steps 2.1a–3.6b, all ticked in `HANDOFF.md`): `apps/web` (package name `web`, Next 16.3, React 19.2.3, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, Vitest 4). Security headers are BUILT in `apps/web/src/lib/security/csp.ts` (2.1a, split by 3.4b) and only APPLIED from `apps/web/next.config.ts` `headers()`; read `csp.ts` and `csp.test.ts` for the exact strings — there are THREE variants: the strict default (`/((?!s/|embed/).*)`: `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, CSP `frame-ancestors 'none'`, `frame-src` limited to `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com` and `https://drive.google.com`, HSTS, `Referrer-Policy`, nosniff); `/s/:path*` (`X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `Cache-Control: private, no-store`, no `X-Frame-Options`, no `frame-ancestors 'none'`); and `/embed/:path*` (`X-Robots-Tag: noindex`, `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin` — the hosted page exists to supply YouTube a referer — no `X-Frame-Options`, no `frame-ancestors 'none'`). Also read `apps/web/proxy.ts` (protected paths exactly `/admin`, `/admin/*`, `/o`, `/o/*`; matcher excludes `/api/stripe/webhook`, `/api/cron/tick`, `/s/*`, `/embed/*`, static assets), `apps/web/src/lib/env.ts` (`publicEnv()`, `serverEnv()` — throws for missing required variables; `stripeConfigured()` reads `process.env` directly), `apps/web/src/lib/security/csp.ts`, and `apps/web/.env.example`.
- Routes that exist (PLAN §8 / DESIGN §9): `(public)` `/`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/s/[token]`, `/embed/yt/[id]`; `(auth)` `/login` (tabs Password / Email code — 2.1b), `/signup`, `/auth/callback` (route handler), `/auth/reset`, `/invite/[token]` (renders a generic page for any token, with an `anacast://invite/<token>` "Open in app" link — 2.1b); `(super)` `/admin/*`; `(org)` `/o/[orgSlug]/{dashboard,sermons,sermons/new,sermons/[id],announcements,announcements/new,announcements/[id]/edit,bulletins,users,users/[membershipId],invitations,settings,settings/billing}`; `api/` `stripe/webhook`, `billing/checkout`, `billing/portal`, `share/[token]/unlock`, `cron/tick`.
- Earlier prompts left instructions for this step: 3.4b says `/s/unknown` must stay 404 with the mock env and its Verify defined "the 3.7 smoke environment" as running WITHOUT `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY` and `SHARE_LINK_COOKIE_SECRET` — this step sets mock values for both (so the no-secret-in-HTML test has literals to grep for); `/s/unknown` → 404 is still asserted and 3.4b's unit tests cover the missing-key path — record the difference in HANDOFF (Finish); 3.6b says `GET /api/cron/tick` without a header returns 401 when `CRON_SECRET` is set and 503 when it is not — this step sets a mock `CRON_SECRET`, so assert 401. 3.2a, 3.2b, 3.5a and 3.5b each asked for a signed-out redirect assertion on their pages (`/o/some-church/users`, `/o/some-church/invitations`, `/o/unknown/announcements`, `/o/unknown/bulletins`) — include them all. 2.6's `docs/DEPLOY.md` (if it exists) tells triage runs to add smoke assertions only once `apps/web/playwright.config.ts` exists — this step creates it.
- CI: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` from step 1.1 (one non-blocking job `checks`; later steps are guarded with `hashFiles(...)`; the web build step already passes a mock env `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:54321`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=sb_publishable_ci_placeholder`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000` — Build item 6 aligns those values with `apps/web/e2e/mock-env.ts` so the CI build can be reused by the smoke run instead of rebuilding).
- Tooling on this machine: Node 22, pnpm 10, Playwright + Chromium already installed (`npx playwright --version`). Do not assume Docker or a hosted Supabase project.
- Pins (PLAN §3 / DESIGN §3): `@playwright/test` 1.62.x. Confirm with `npm view @playwright/test version` that the 1.62 line exists; never bump the major.

## Build
1. **Dependencies and scripts.** In `apps/web/package.json` add devDependency `@playwright/test` ~1.62 (exact minor from `npm view`). Add scripts: `test:e2e` → `playwright test`, `test:e2e:smoke` → `playwright test --project=smoke`, `test:e2e:full` → `playwright test --project=full` (the `full` project is defined in 3.7b; define the script now so the docs are stable), `test:e2e:report` → `playwright show-report`. Do NOT add Playwright to the `test` script or to Turbo's `test` task — `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` must stay fast and network-free. Add a Turbo task `e2e` in `turbo.json` (`cache: false`, `dependsOn: ["^build"]`, `env` list identical to `build` plus `BASE_URL`, `E2E_*`) so `pnpm turbo e2e --filter web` works. Add `apps/web/playwright-report/`, `apps/web/test-results/` and `apps/web/e2e/.auth/` to `.gitignore`.
2. **`apps/web/playwright.config.ts`** (package root; `testDir: './e2e'`; DESIGN §11 step 9 writes `apps/web/e2e/playwright.config.ts` — put the config at the package root so `pnpm --filter web exec playwright test` finds it without flags, and note the wording in HANDOFF). Contents:
   - `const baseURL = process.env.BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3100'`; `webServer` only when `BASE_URL` is unset: `command: process.env.CI && existsSync('.next/BUILD_ID') ? 'pnpm start -- --port 3100' : 'pnpm build && pnpm start -- --port 3100'` (in CI the 1.1 web-build step has already built the app with the same mock env — see Build 6 — so do not build twice; `existsSync` from `node:fs`), `cwd` = `apps/web`, `url: baseURL`, `reuseExistingServer: !process.env.CI`, `timeout: process.env.CI ? 600_000 : 240_000`, and `env` = the **mock environment** defined in one place, `apps/web/e2e/mock-env.ts` (exported object, also re-used by 3.7b): `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:54321`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=sb_publishable_ci_placeholder`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY=sb_secret_mock_value_must_never_appear_in_html`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3100`, `SHARE_LINK_COOKIE_SECRET=<a 44-character base64 literal generated once and committed — it protects nothing>`, `CRON_SECRET=mock-cron-secret`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_UPLOAD_MB=50`, and NO `STRIPE_*` / `RESEND_*` (so the Stripe banner, the webhook 503 and the copy-link invitation path are exercised). Build with the mock env too: `next build` must succeed with these values (2.1a designed `serverEnv()` for exactly this).
   - `projects`: `smoke` (`testMatch: /smoke\.spec\.ts/`, Chromium desktop) and `smoke-mobile` (same files, `devices['Pixel 7']`) — the responsive pass costs nothing extra. Leave a commented `full` project placeholder for 3.7b.
   - `use`: `baseURL`, `trace: 'retain-on-failure'`, `screenshot: 'only-on-failure'`, `video: 'off'`; `reporter: [['list'], ['html', { open: 'never' }]]`; `forbidOnly: !!process.env.CI`; `retries: process.env.CI ? 1 : 0`; `workers: process.env.CI ? 2 : undefined`; `expect.timeout: 10_000`.
3. **Helpers — `apps/web/e2e/helpers/headers.ts`**. Export a tiny `cspDirective(csp: string, name: string): string[]` parser (split on `;`, find the directive, return its source tokens — never assert on raw string order) and three assertion helpers, one per header variant of `csp.ts`: `expectStrictHeaders(response)` — `content-security-policy` present, `cspDirective(csp, 'frame-ancestors')` equals `["'none'"]`, `cspDirective(csp, 'frame-src')` CONTAINS both `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com` and `https://drive.google.com` (any order; other hosts allowed), `strict-transport-security` present, `referrer-policy` present, `x-content-type-options: nosniff`, `x-frame-options: DENY`; `expectShareHeaders(response)` (for `/s/*`) — CSP present and its `frame-ancestors` directive is either absent or does NOT contain `'none'` (if present it is `*`), `x-robots-tag` contains `noindex`, `referrer-policy: no-referrer`, `cache-control` contains `no-store`, header `x-frame-options` absent; `expectEmbedHeaders(response)` (for `/embed/*`) — CSP present and its `frame-ancestors` directive is absent or does not contain `'none'`, `x-robots-tag` contains `noindex`, `referrer-policy` equals the value `csp.ts` sets for `/embed/:path*` (3.4b: `strict-origin-when-cross-origin` — read the file and assert that exact value), header `x-frame-options` absent. Never use `expectShareHeaders` on an embed page or vice versa — the two variants differ on purpose. `apps/web/e2e/helpers/routes.ts` exporting `PROTECTED_PATHS` = `['/admin', '/admin/churches/new', '/admin/fellowships', '/admin/super-admins', '/o', '/o/some-church', '/o/some-church/dashboard', '/o/some-church/users', '/o/some-church/invitations', '/o/unknown/announcements', '/o/unknown/bulletins', '/o/some-church/sermons', '/o/some-church/sermons/new', '/o/some-church/settings', '/o/some-church/settings/billing']` and `PUBLIC_PATHS` = `['/', '/privacy', '/terms', '/login', '/signup', '/auth/reset', '/invite/not-a-real-token']` (the invite page renders a generic "you have been invited" page for any token under the mock env — 2.1b — so it belongs in the render checks; PLAN §8 lists it as reachable without a session).
4. **`apps/web/e2e/smoke.spec.ts`** — one `test.describe` per area, every test independent, no shared state, no sleeps (use `expect(...).toHaveURL`, `toBeVisible`, `toPass`):
   1. *Public pages render*: for each of `PUBLIC_PATHS`, `page.goto` → status 200, exactly one `h1` visible, `<html lang="en">`, a non-empty `<title>`, no `console.error` entries (collect via `page.on('console')`, ignore the known Next dev-only noise only if the app is running `next dev` — it is not, so expect zero), no failed requests to first-party URLs (`page.on('requestfailed')`; requests to `localhost:54321` may fail and are expected — filter them out and assert they never block rendering). For `/invite/not-a-real-token` additionally assert the body contains the deep link `anacast://invite/not-a-real-token` (the "Open in app" link from 2.1b) and a "Sign in" control.
   2. *Unauthenticated redirects*: for each of `PROTECTED_PATHS`, `page.goto(path)` ends at `/login?next=<encodeURIComponent(path)>`; `request.get(path, { maxRedirects: 0 })` returns 307 or 308 with a `location` header starting with `/login?next=`. Also assert `/other`, `/privacy` and `/s/unknown` are NOT redirected.
   3. *Login form validation*: on `/login` submit empty → the email field shows its error text (find the `aria-describedby` target or the shadcn `FormMessage`); type `not-an-email` → an invalid-email message; type a valid email and a password → the request to `localhost:54321` fails → the page shows the mapped generic error text from `src/lib/supabase/errors.ts` (read that module and assert the exact string, not a regex) and never a raw stack trace. Switch to the **Email code** tab of `/login` (2.1b builds tabs Password / Email code — read `src/features/auth/LoginForm.tsx` for the control name; PLAN §8 defines `/login` as "password + OTP", so the mode MUST exist — do not make this conditional); assert the 6-digit code field appears only after "Send code", and that submitting the email under the mock env shows the mapped generic error, never a stack trace. `/signup` gets the same empty-submit and invalid-email checks.
   4. *Share and embed*: `request.get('/s/unknown')` → 404 with `expectShareHeaders`; `page.goto('/s/unknown')` shows the "link not available" copy from 3.4b (read `app/(public)/s/[token]/page.tsx` for the exact text). `request.post('/api/share/unknown/unlock', { form: { password: 'whatever' } })` → 404 or 400 (read `app/api/share/[token]/unlock/route.ts` and assert the documented code), never 500. `request.get('/embed/yt/dQw4w9WgXcQ')` → 200, `expectEmbedHeaders` (NOT `expectShareHeaders` — the embed page carries `strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, not `no-referrer`), body contains `youtube-nocookie.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ`; `/embed/yt/not-eleven-chars` → 404.
   5. *Security headers*: `expectStrictHeaders` on `/`, `/privacy`, `/login`, `/invite/not-a-real-token` and `/definitely-not-a-route`; for the `/admin` redirect assert only that the 307/308 has a `location` starting with `/login?next=` and — IF the response carries a `content-security-policy` header at all — that it satisfies `expectStrictHeaders` (redirects produced by `proxy.ts` do not reliably carry `next.config.ts` `headers()` entries; record in `e2e/README.md` whether they do on this build); `expectShareHeaders` on `/s/unknown`; `expectEmbedHeaders` on `/embed/yt/dQw4w9WgXcQ`. Assert `/privacy` HTML contains no `<script src=` pointing at a host other than the app itself (CSP `script-src` sanity).
   6. *Operational routes refuse strangers*: `GET /api/cron/tick` without header → 401 (mock `CRON_SECRET` is set); with `Authorization: Bearer wrong` → 401; `GET /api/cron/tick?secret=mock-cron-secret` → 401 (query string never accepted — 3.6b). `POST /api/stripe/webhook` with any body → 503 (no `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`) and the body says Stripe is not configured (read 2.3's route for the exact text). `POST /api/billing/checkout` and `POST /api/billing/portal`: read `app/api/billing/{checkout,portal}/route.ts` (2.3) first — the routes run a same-origin check BEFORE authentication and export `POST` only. Assert: `request.post(path, { data: {} })` with NO `Origin` header → 403 with JSON `{ error: 'bad_origin' }`; with header `Origin: <baseURL>` while signed out → 401 `{ error: 'unauthorized' }` (under the mock env the Stripe-configured check may instead answer 503 `{ error: 'stripe_not_configured' }` if it runs before auth — assert whichever order the route implements and say so in a comment); in every case the JSON `error` key is one of `bad_origin` / `unauthorized` / `stripe_not_configured`, never a 500 and never a redirect to `/login` (`proxy.ts` redirects only `/admin*` and `/o*` — API routes answer JSON themselves). `GET /auth/callback` without `code`/`token_hash` → 3xx to `/login` (2.1b redirects to `/login?error=auth` or the landing — read `app/(auth)/auth/callback/route.ts` and assert the documented target), never 500. `GET /api/cron/tick` response has `cache-control: no-store` if 3.6b set it (read the route; assert what it does).
   7. *No secret in HTML*: for `/`, `/login`, `/privacy`, `/invite/not-a-real-token`, `/s/unknown`, `/embed/yt/dQw4w9WgXcQ` the response body does not contain `sb_secret_`, `service_role`, `mock-cron-secret`, or the `SHARE_LINK_COOKIE_SECRET` literal. Also fetch every `<script src>` of `/login` that is same-origin and assert the same on those chunks (the mock `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY` value is unique enough to grep for).
   8. *Not found*: `/definitely-not-a-route` → 404 rendered by `app/not-found.tsx` (assert the copy), `expectStrictHeaders`.
5. **`apps/web/e2e/README.md`**: how to run (`pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke`; against a deployment `BASE_URL=https://<VERCEL_URL> pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke`), what the mock env is and why it is safe to commit, how to open the report, where 3.7b's full suite plugs in (`E2E_*` variables from `docs/ENV.md`), and the rule "a failing smoke test blocks a push; fix the app or the test in the same commit".
6. **CI.** In `.github/workflows/ci.yml` first change the 1.1 web-build step's mock env to EXACTLY the values in `apps/web/e2e/mock-env.ts` (in particular `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3100`, plus `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, `SHARE_LINK_COOKIE_SECRET`, `CRON_SECRET`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_UPLOAD_MB=50` — `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` values are baked in at build time, so the build the smoke run reuses must have been made with the same values; put a comment in both files pointing at the other). Then add, after the web build step and guarded with `if: hashFiles('apps/web/playwright.config.ts') != ''`: `pnpm --filter web exec playwright install --with-deps chromium` (cache `~/.cache/ms-playwright` keyed on the Playwright version), then `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` with `CI=true`, then `actions/upload-artifact@v4` of `apps/web/playwright-report` with `if: failure()` and `retention-days: 7`. The workflow stays `continue-on-error: true` (step 1.1's decision) — do not make it blocking here; 3.8 documents the policy.
7. **Warning-free build.** Run `pnpm --filter web build` with the mock env and fix every warning the build prints (unused exports, `next/image` hints, `metadata` warnings, edge/node runtime notices, dynamic-server-usage messages caused by reading cookies in a static page). Fix the cause, never suppress with `eslint-disable` or `// @ts-expect-error`. Record the list of warnings you removed in `session_log.md`.
8. **Smoke-test hooks in the app, only where needed.** If an assertion needs a stable selector, prefer accessible roles and labels (`getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })`, `getByLabel('Email')`); add `data-testid` only when no accessible handle exists, named `<feature>-<element>` (for example `share-unavailable`). Never change behaviour to make a test pass; if a test exposes a real defect (a protected page not redirecting, a header missing, a 500 on an anonymous API call) fix the defect in the owning module and add a Vitest unit test next to the existing ones.

## Constraints
- Mock env only: no Supabase project, no Stripe key, no Resend key, no network. If a test needs a real backend it belongs in 3.7b's `full` project, not here.
- Do not add Playwright to Turbo's `test` task, do not run it in `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test`, and do not introduce `sleep`/`waitForTimeout` calls.
- Pins: `@playwright/test` 1.62 line; no other new runtime dependency. Chromium only (Firefox/WebKit are not installed on the founder's machines and add nothing for this app).
- Do not refactor pages, guards, headers or API routes beyond fixing a defect a test proved. Do not touch `supabase/`, `packages/*` behaviour, or mobile. Never `supabase db push`/`db reset`.
- No real email address, key, token or domain in tests or docs — use the mock values and `<VERCEL_URL>`.
- Keep `continue-on-error: true` on the CI job (1.1 decided the workflow is informational).

## Verify
- `pnpm install` → lockfile updated with `@playwright/test` only; `npx playwright --version` → 1.62.x.
- `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` → green (the e2e files are type-checked by `apps/web/tsconfig.json` — include `e2e/**/*.ts` and `playwright.config.ts` in it; exclude them from Vitest's `include`).
- `pnpm --filter web build` with the mock env exported → exit 0 and zero warnings in the output.
- `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` → all tests pass in both `smoke` and `smoke-mobile`; runtime under 3 minutes after the build; `apps/web/playwright-report/index.html` is produced; `git status` shows no report or `test-results` files.
- Deliberately break one thing locally without committing (temporarily drop `X-Frame-Options` from the strict set in `src/lib/security/csp.ts` — `next.config.ts` only applies what `csp.ts` builds) → `test:e2e:smoke` fails on the headers test (and `csp.test.ts` fails too); restore it.
- `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3100 pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` with the server already running from `pnpm --filter web start -- --port 3100` → passes without starting a second server.
- After pushing, the GitHub Actions run shows the Playwright step executed (green) and no artifact was uploaded.

## Finish
- `HANDOFF.md`: under State add "Web QA: Playwright harness + smoke (3.7a) — done; full E2E/a11y/states audit in 3.7b"; under "Version pins worth remembering" add the Playwright version; under "Deviations from plan" note the config location `apps/web/playwright.config.ts` (DESIGN §11 step 9 draws it under `e2e/`) that the smoke `CRON_SECRET` is set (so the cron route is asserted as 401, not 503), and that 3.4b assumed the smoke env lacks `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`/`SHARE_LINK_COOKIE_SECRET` while 3.7a sets mock values for both (the no-secret-in-HTML test greps for them; `/s/unknown` → 404 is still asserted and 3.4b's unit test covers the missing-key path); note whether middleware redirects carry the security headers; list any defect the suite exposed and how it was fixed.
- Tick step 3.7a in `docs/TODO.md`; write `session_log.md`; commit `test(web): Playwright harness, mock-env smoke suite and CI step`; push `main` (`git push origin main`) unless another branch was named.
- If anything in the plan proves impossible or wrong (for example a route that cannot render under the mock env), do the closest correct thing, record it in HANDOFF.md under "Deviations from plan", and report it in your final message.
done_when: `apps/web/playwright.config.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/mock-env.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/helpers/{headers,routes}.ts` (with `expectStrictHeaders`, `expectShareHeaders`, `expectEmbedHeaders` and a `cspDirective` parser), `apps/web/e2e/smoke.spec.ts` and `apps/web/e2e/README.md` exist; `@playwright/test` is on the 1.62 line; scripts `test:e2e`, `test:e2e:smoke`, `test:e2e:full`, `test:e2e:report` are in `apps/web/package.json`; Playwright is not part of Turbo's `test` task.
`pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` passes in projects `smoke` and `smoke-mobile` with no hosted Supabase, Stripe or Resend configured, and finishes in under 3 minutes after the build.

## Goal
When you finish, the Playwright `full` project exists and encodes the Phase 1 acceptance script from PLAN §12 end to end against a real Supabase project: super admin signs in → creates a church → creates its first admin directly → that admin creates a second account and toggles permissions (and the last manager can be stripped of neither permissions nor status) → invites a third person by link and the invitee accepts → uploads a small mp3 sermon and links a YouTube sermon → publishes → creates a password-protected share link → an anonymous browser unlocks it → the church disables sharing → the same link is a 404. A second spec proves a member without permissions is refused everywhere. The suite is skipped cleanly when the `E2E_*` variables are absent, runs locally against the hosted project (with the app started in a dedicated `E2E_MODE=full` server mode) or against a deployed `BASE_URL`, and cleans up everything it created. `docs/QA_WEB.md` documents both suites so the founder can run one command before Checkpoint B.

## Build
1. **Config and server modes.** In `apps/web/playwright.config.ts` add project `full`: `testMatch: /full\/.*\.spec\.ts/`, Chromium desktop, `fullyParallel: false`, `workers: 1` (a per-project option since Playwright 1.52; if the `TestProject` type rejects it, drop it — the script also forces one worker), `timeout: 120_000`, `retries: 0`. Change the `test:e2e:full` script to `E2E_MODE=full playwright test --project=full --workers=1` (document the Windows form in the README). Add `apps/web/e2e/full/env.ts` exporting `e2eEnv()` that reads the four `E2E_*` variables and `BASE_URL`, returns `null` when any `E2E_*` is missing, and `hasE2E = e2eEnv() !== null && process.env.E2E_MODE === 'full'`; every full spec starts with `test.skip(!hasE2E, 'E2E_* not set or E2E_MODE !== full — see docs/ENV.md')` so `pnpm --filter web test:e2e` never fails for lack of credentials. Keep the mock env for the smoke projects untouched.
2. **Fixture file.** `apps/web/e2e/fixtures/small.mp3` — a valid MPEG-1 Layer III file, ≈ 2 s, under 64 KB. Use `ffmpeg -f lavfi -i anullsrc=r=44100:cl=mono -t 2 -b:a 32k apps/web/e2e/fixtures/small.mp3` if `ffmpeg` exists; otherwise write `apps/web/e2e/fixtures/make-small-mp3.mjs` emitting ~80 frames, each = header `FF FB 10 C0` (MPEG-1, Layer III, no CRC, bitrate index 1 = 32 kbps, 44.1 kHz, no padding, mono) + 100 zero bytes = 104-byte frames (144 × 32000 / 44100 ≈ 104), ≈ 8 KB — commit the output. Guard it with a Vitest test that walks the file: every 104-byte offset starts with `FF FB` and the size is under 64 KB.
3. **Runner-side helpers — `apps/web/e2e/full/supabase-admin.ts`** (Node only, imports `@supabase/supabase-js` with the secret key): `createRunTag()` → `e2e-<yyyymmdd>-<6 random chars>` (unique per run — repeat runs never collide on slug or email even if cleanup failed); `cleanupRun(tag)` — a deliberate, **test-runner-only exception** to DESIGN §4 "hard org deletion is forbidden" (say so in `docs/QA_WEB.md` and in HANDOFF "Deviations from plan"), executed only for rows tagged by this run: (1) delete the run's `auth.users` (`auth.admin.listUsers` filtered to `<tag>+*@example.invalid` → `deleteUser`); (2) read the FK definitions in `9999_init.sql` and delete the org's rows in dependency order — `org_membership_permissions`, `org_memberships` (`app.guard_last_org_manager` blocks removing the last manager unless at trigger depth > 1 or with `app.cascade = 'on'`, which a PostgREST client cannot set — if refused with `last_org_manager`, skip to (3)), `sermon_share_links`, `sermons`, `announcements`, `bulletins`, `notifications`, `persons` before `households` (`persons.household_id` is `on delete no action`), `surveys` before `audience_groups`, `audit_log` / `billing_*` / `storage_deletions` rows, `organization_settings`; (3) `delete from organizations where slug like '<tag>%'` (cascades remove whatever (2) left; a cascade fires the guard at depth > 1, which it skips); (4) if any step is refused, fall back to `update organizations set status = 'cancelled'` (`srv_housekeeping` purges it after 30 days), print the leftover slug and document this path in `docs/QA_WEB.md`; (5) enqueue `storage_deletions` (`bucket = 'sermon-media'`, `object_name = '<org_id>/'`, `is_prefix = true`) as `srv_housekeeping` does; 3.6b's orphan sweep is the backstop. ## Goal
When you finish, every page the web app ships so far passes an automated axe scan (WCAG 2.0 A/AA, no `serious`/`critical` violations) plus a manual pass of labels, focus and contrast, and every route in PLAN §8 has been audited for empty, loading and error states: `loading.tsx`, `error.tsx` and `not-found.tsx` exist at the root, `(super)` and `(org)` levels, every list page renders an explicit empty state with one primary action, every mutation surfaces failures through the `ActionResult` convention and a toast, and the whole audit is recorded as a table in `docs/QA_WEB.md` with one row per PLAN §8 route. ## Inputs / prior state
- Step 3.7a: Playwright harness, `apps/web/e2e/smoke.spec.ts`, helpers, mock env. - Routes to audit — copy the list from PLAN §8 verbatim: `(public)` `/`, `/s/[token]`, `/embed/yt/[id]`, `/privacy`, `/terms`; `(auth)` `/login`, `/signup`, `/auth/callback` (route handler — row reads n/a for UI columns), `/auth/reset`, `/invite/[token]`; `(super)` `/admin`, `/admin/churches/new`, `/admin/churches/[orgId]` (five tabs — one row per tab), `/admin/fellowships`, `/admin/fellowships/[id]`, `/admin/super-admins`; `(org)` `/o/[orgSlug]/dashboard`, `/sermons`, `/sermons/new`, `/sermons/[id]`, `/announcements`, `/announcements/new`, `/announcements/[id]/edit`, `/bulletins`, `/users`, `/users/[membershipId]`, `/invitations`, `/settings`, `/settings/billing`.

## Build
1. **Dependency.** Add devDependency `@axe-core/playwright` to `apps/web` — pin the exact version from `npm view @axe-core/playwright version` (4.x line) and record it under HANDOFF "Version pins worth remembering"; it is a dependency beyond PLAN §3 / DESIGN §3, so list it under "Deviations from plan" too. No other new dependency.
2. **Scan helper.** `apps/web/e2e/helpers/a11y.ts` exporting `expectNoSeriousA11yViolations(page, { disableRules? })` — runs `AxeBuilder` with tags `wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`; fails on `serious`/`critical`; attaches the full result (`testInfo.attach`) so `moderate`/`minor` findings are visible in the report. Call it in `smoke.spec.ts` for every `PUBLIC_PATHS` entry (including `/invite/not-a-real-token`), `/s/unknown` and the 404 page — in both `smoke` and `smoke-mobile` — and in `full/01-acceptance.spec.ts` after each major page (`/admin`, the church page on every tab, `/o/<tag>/dashboard`, `/users`, `/users/<membershipId>`, `/invitations`, `/sermons`, `/sermons/new` both tabs, `/sermons/<id>`, `/settings`, `/settings/billing`, `/announcements`, `/announcements/new`, `/bulletins`, `/s/<token>` locked and unlocked). Scans in the full spec are gated exactly like the rest of that spec (3.7b's `hasE2E`); scans in the smoke spec must pass under the mock env.
3. **Manual accessibility pass — fix in the owning components.** Every input has a `<label>` or `aria-label` (`getByLabel` must work for every field in `ChurchForm`, `SettingsForm`, `SermonForm`, `AnnouncementForm`, the bulletin form, the login/signup/reset forms, `CreateAdminDialog`, `CreateAccountDialog`, `InviteDialog`, the share-link create form); every icon-only button has `aria-label`; dialogs trap focus and return it to the trigger; the permission grid checkboxes are reachable by keyboard and announce the user name + permission label (`aria-label="<name> — <permission label>"` or an `aria-labelledby` pair); the org switcher and the row-action menus are operable with arrow keys and Escape; tables have `<th scope>`; the trial / `past_due` / `suspended` banners use `role="status"` and are not colour-only; a "Skip to content" link is the first focusable element in `app/layout.tsx`; every page sets a distinct `<title>` via `metadata`/`generateMetadata` ("<Page> · <Church> · Anacast" for org pages, "<Page> · Admin · Anacast" for super admin, "<Page> · Anacast" elsewhere).

Text/background contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for body text and ≥ 3:1 for large text and UI borders that carry meaning (badge colours from `StatusBadge`, muted text, placeholder text, disabled controls that still convey state): measure the neutral tokens (axe reports the ratios), fix in the same `@theme` block, and list every token you changed with old → new values in `docs/QA_WEB.md` and HANDOFF. Do not introduce brand colours (founder decision 9: still open).
5. **Loading / error / not-found files.** Ensure these exist and follow one pattern: `app/loading.tsx`, `app/(super)/admin/loading.tsx`, `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/loading.tsx` (content skeletons matching the page shells, not spinners); `app/error.tsx`, `app/global-error.tsx`, `app/(super)/admin/error.tsx`, `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/error.tsx` (client components: friendly message + "Try again" calling `reset()`, the error `digest` shown in small text for support, never `error.message` in production); `app/not-found.tsx`, `app/(super)/admin/not-found.tsx`, `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/not-found.tsx` (3.1's exists — align its copy); keep `forbidden.tsx` where HANDOFF says `forbidden()` is live.
6. **Empty states.** Every list page — `/admin`, `/admin/fellowships`, `/admin/super-admins`, `/admin/churches/[orgId]` Fellowships and Admins tabs, `/o/[orgSlug]/{sermons,announcements,bulletins,users,invitations}`, the `ShareLinksPanel` on `/sermons/[id]`, the dashboard cards — renders an explicit empty state with one sentence and ONE primary action the actor is allowed to take (hide the action when `requirePerm` would refuse it; show a sentence naming the permission instead). Reuse `src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx` if an earlier step created it; create it if not and migrate the existing ad-hoc empty states to it (copy stays the same).
7. **Error surfacing.** Every mutation surfaces failure through the `ActionResult` convention and a toast (never an unhandled rejection or a raw Postgres/Supabase message); every `useQuery` shows a skeleton while pending and the mapped error text on failure; forms disable their submit button while pending and re-enable on error. Grep for `console.error`/`throw` in `src/features/**` client components and route them through `toActionError`.
8. **Audit table.** Replace the "Route audit (3.7c)" placeholder in `docs/QA_WEB.md` with a table having ONE ROW FOR EVERY ROUTE in PLAN §8 (copy the list verbatim, one row per tab of `/admin/churches/[orgId]`; not only list pages) — columns: route | empty | loading | error | a11y scan | title | notes. For form pages the empty column reads "n/a" and the error column records how a failed Server Action is shown; for `/auth/callback` (route handler) and `/embed/yt/[id]` the UI columns read "n/a — <reason>". No cell may say "missing" when you finish. Also record the theme tokens changed (Build 4) and the manual keyboard pass result.
9. **Regression guards.** Add Vitest tests for `empty-state.tsx` and for the `generateMetadata` helpers (distinct titles); add smoke assertions that the "Skip to content" link is the first focusable element on `/` and `/login` and that the 404 page has a `<title>`.

With no hosted project available, do the pass on the pages the mock env can render and record the rest as "pending hosted run" in `docs/QA_WEB.md`.
- `docs/QA_WEB.md` audit table has a row for every PLAN §8 route (count them against the list) and no cell says "missing"; `ls apps/web/app/**/{loading,error,not-found}.tsx` shows the three levels.
